=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text s0 "Hello,"
text more " World!"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note copyto copies s into d at offset off and returns the offset after it (past the end traps 3)
fn copyto d edit uchar * off ulong s view uchar * to ulong
for i ulong len s
put d add off i get s i
end
ret add off len s
end
fn main to int
note the string lives in a 64-byte buffer b with length n; appending copies after byte n
b = new uchar 64 0
n = copyto b 0 s0
n = copyto b n more
emit part b 0 n
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
Hello, World!
</pre>
